verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a Learnings knowledge base: it learns review preferences from chat conversations and applies them automatically to future reviews, and it 'learns from your team's feedback'. Team conventions also persist through auto-detected guideline files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules), org-wide central configuration, and stored learnings covered by data-retention controls. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that learnings measurably change later reviews (the only community mention says it 'supposedly' remembers), and explicit evidence that it captures past accept/reject review decisions automatically rather than only preferences taught through chat.
